description: 1. Agent reads the SKILL.md to understand the humanizer-rewrite workflow. 2. Agent reads /workspace/content/drafts/product_launch_article.txt and finds the clearly AI-generated text full of clichés like 随着…的发展, 综上所述, 未来可期, etc. 3. Agent initiates Round 1: The Executor (E) produces a first draft, injecting at least 3 humanization techniques from the named table (口语锚点, 观点突袭, 自我矛盾, 具体细节锚定, 句子截断, 反转一次). 4. The Critic (C) scores 5 dimensions (去套话程度, 情绪与观点密度, 句式多样性, 反常识表达, 结尾自然度) each 1-5. The critic must append the exact anti-defense lock sentence: '我的批评维持原判，请在下一轮修改中证明。' 5. The Judge (J) calculates the average score: if < 4, continues to round 2 (max 3 rounds); if ≥ 4, terminates. 6. Each round is formatted with the exact ═══ separator lines and 【第 N 轮 · 执行者草稿】/【第 N 轮 · 批评者 AI 味诊断】/【第 N 轮 · 裁判者决策】 headers as specified. 7. After iteration terminates, the final rewritten article is written back to the original file path, overwriting it. The proprietary traps: (a) the triangular E→C→J loop with scoring termination logic (avg<4 = iterate, ≥4 = stop, max 3 rounds), (b) the mandatory anti-defense lock sentence in the critic section, (c) the specific named humanization injection techniques table, (d) the exact output format with ═══ borders.
